summary: Frontend smoke + functional test for BetaTycoon V17 Movie Tycoon. Verified setup→dashboard flow, External IP page (Inbound/My Licenses/Outbound tabs), Outbound listing modal, and dashboard navigation tiles. Could not exercise inbound IP COUNTER modal (no offers spawned after 36 simulated weeks) or streaming-detail tier-picker (player has not yet launched a streaming service / has no released owned movies). Default tiers (Basic/Standard/Premium) verified by code review of /app/frontend/src/game/data.ts defaultTiers().

integration_issues.issue: After simulating 36 weeks from a fresh save, zero pending inbound IP offers spawned. Counter modal (c-fee/c-bo/...) could not be exercised. Spawn rate may be too low or gated by progression criteria not yet met. Recommend reducing minimum threshold or seeding 1 offer at game start for UX.

Could not reach streaming/[id] flow — player must first 'Launch Streaming Service' AND have released owned movies. Not auto-tested in this run. Code review of /app/frontend/app/streaming/[id].tsx confirms presence of testIDs add-quick-all, add-quick-top, add-tier-{tierId}, confirm-add-tiers, cancel-add-tiers, edit-tier-access-{movieId}, edit-tier-{tierId}, save-tier-access — all correctly wired.
Not exercised in this run (would require navigating rivals → relations → bulk catalog offer flow with sufficient rival relationship + released catalog).

/app/frontend/app/streaming/[id].tsx — addMovieToStreaming default sets all tiers selected on open; submit handler in onPress (line ~531) requires non-empty addTierIds and only persists movieTierAccess when fewer than all selected (handled by underlying addMovieToStreaming/setMovieTierAccess in state).

rca_of_issue: Inbound External IP offers not spawning within 36 simulated weeks.
